decisionsTitle: Five small things of an evening: the ☰ at the right edge, «Spune-ne ceva (anonim)», two more rules on the design page, no first name in the fixtures, the plan's decision 3
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-10 evening,** asked for five small things.

1. **The ☰ flush right.** «On the header the spacing should be space-between so that the hamburger is all the way to the right.» On a phone the logo stood left and «Alergări Calendar Echipa ☰» clustered after it, with empty room at the right. The fold button's wrapper in `SiteNav` now carries `margin-left: auto`, so the button sits at the row's right edge at every width while the entries stay left beside the logo. A margin is outside `getBoundingClientRect().width`, which is what the self-measuring fold reads, so the measurement is unchanged and the row stays one line at 320 px; a folded (absent) button is out of the flow and takes no margin. Amends §262 and §537.

2. **«Spune-ne ceva (anonim)» / "Tell us something (anonymous)".** Anonymous is the default (§678) and the club wants to encourage feedback, so the contact page's section heading and the wizard's title say it (`Tell.title`, both catalogues). The privacy notice's `{{feedbackForms}}` clause used to read the same key, so the new words would have silently stopped matching a notice the club already approved; the clause now reads its own key, `Tell.noticeName`, which keeps the old words («Spune-ne ceva» / "Tell us something"). Amends §678 and §679.

3. **Two more «Reguli» rows** on `/admin/design`: `serverFirst` (Server Components first; a client island earns its place) and `iconFamily` (one filled Material family; a glyph on every button and fold), each with the files and tests that hold it (§318, §521; the glyph rule cites `glyph-on-every-button-and-fold.test.ts`). Nineteen rules become twenty-one. Amends §692.

4. **No person's name in the repository.** The owner's first name and surname stood in fixtures, tests and comments (the declaration-signature specs, the name-fold and signature-name notes, the declare page's comment, an email-suggestion test, the canonical-email note, several integration fixtures). They are now neutral sample names («Felix», «Sample», `sample.runner@exemplu33.com`, `s.ample@gmail.com`). The email sample's list of the former inviter (`EMAIL_SAMPLE_FORMER_INVITER`, §359) is **deleted** rather than renamed: it held the owner's first name, and a neutral stand-in would have been a value the old editor never wrote and would have been a false claim. What it did: a text saved from the old editor before §359 that still carried the platform's sentence «<name> te-a adăugat în echipa…» was flagged on save. Without it such a text is no longer flagged for the inviter and, if one exists, would tell invited volunteers that the owner added them. **To check before landing:** `/admin` → the email texts of STAFF_INVITATION and MEMBER_INVITATION on production and QA for a saved text still holding that sentence with a literal first name (the copy rows could not be queried from the branch session); if one exists, re-save it from the editor. The clone URL in `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` is the repository's address, not a person's name, and stays.

5. **The plan: decision 3 decided, and the component rule.** `redesign-plan.ts` marks decision 3 `decided`, both catalogues say what was decided: a real home page at `/ro` and `/en`, reached from the logo and never a menu entry, switchable on and off in «Aspect» → «Pagina principală». `docs/REDESIGN.md` marks the row decided, names phase 3's settings (the home page switch, the hero picture with its crop, two lines and three button targets, N gallery pictures per strip or carousel in order, the founding date and the runners figure, an unset strip not drawn) and gains the paragraph «Component-based, by the owner's rule»: one named Server Component per section under `src/modules/home/ui/`, typed props, no element-valued prop, tokens only from `brand.ts`, each drawn on `/admin/design` → «Mostre», carousels CSS scroll-snap strips with no island, everything the club sees a setting.

**Refused:** a wider header rework (the facelift's phase 1 owns the header) and any wording change beyond the one title; the wizard's layout (§676–§680, §695–§696) is untouched.

**Documents written on the branch:** `docs/REDESIGN.md`. No migration, no new dependency.
changelogLine: - **The ☰ at the right edge, «Spune-ne ceva (anonim)»** — the header's overflow button sits flush right at every width; the contact page's feedback heading and the wizard's title say it is anonymous; two more rules on the design page; no first name in the fixtures; the redesign plan's decision 3 decided. §NNN.
